name: Epaphroditus
overview: Epaphroditus was a devoted servant and messenger of the Apostle Paul, entrusted with ministering to Paul's needs and representing the Philippian believers. Scripture highlights his deep care for the church and his willingness to risk his life for the work of Christ, even becoming dangerously ill while in Rome. God's mercy preserved him, allowing him to continue serving faithfully, and Paul commends the gifts Epaphroditus brought as a fragrant offering pleasing to God.
